notes: THE WINDOW SAYS WHAT THE PRODUCT IS CALLED. Every part of the app already called itself MoRaj Ledger — the sign-in screen, the sidebar beneath your organisation's name, the update notice. The window title said "MoRaj Finance Suite", which is the internal name of the build and the one place a customer could still see the plumbing. It now says MoRaj Ledger. A TRIAL SAYS SO. The trial copy titles its window "MoRaj Ledger — Trial". A trial and a paid copy can sit on the same computer, each with its own separate books, and nobody should have to work out which window they are about to type a real transaction into. Nothing else changed: no figure, no report, no posting rule. This is 0.8.63 with the name on the window corrected. If you are on 0.8.63 there is no urgency to take it, and no migration to run — your books are untouched either way.
